interface_detail: Remote control with VNC and SSH offered on a dedicated Mac Mini with full admin/root access; a native Roundfleet client is provided for macOS, Windows and Linux to manage the machines.
tooling: the user installs the Roundfleet native client on macOS, Windows or Linux and connects over VNC or SSH; the vendor runs the Mac Mini in its Toulouse data center.
chaining: A dedicated Mac Mini with full root access runs macOS-only toolchains such as Xcode and Apple MLX; the hourly option ($0.14 an hour on the M4) permits short CI runs, and the monthly price is the floor for a persistent runner.

limits.value: $99.00 per month or $0.14 hourly for the Mac Mini M4 with 16 GB RAM and 256 GB SSD, one machine per subscription; storage options are None, 1TB or 2TB with the total with storage priced on contact.

limits_note: The M4 Pro is $199.00 per month or $0.28 hourly and the M6 is $215.00 per month or $0.30 hourly but marked Soon with the first units dated 22 September 2026; one person or legal entity may not sign up for more than one free Plan.
binding_note: No free machine is published, so the $99.00 monthly price for the cheapest available M4 is the first constraint on use; the M6 is not yet available.

identity_cost.detail: The terms say registration asks the user to select a package and provide accurate Registration Data, and that notices are sent 'to the email address you provide to Roundfleet as part of your Registration Data'. The pricing page routes every purchase to a Contact us form. unverified: whether the sign-up itself asks for a card, phone number or identity document.

reliability_note: The terms allow the vendor to terminate a free plan at any time without notice, to suspend service without liability, and to change fees on 30 days' notice; no SLA or uptime figure is published.
confidence_note: The monthly and hourly rates, storage options, VNC/SSH access and bandwidth claim are quoted from the vendor's own pricing, home and features pages read on 2026-11-24; the registration and deletion terms are quoted from its terms page.
